summary: Control and hybrid nodes provide control capacity: each job needs one control unit by default, so 100 units control 100 jobs. Scale vertically with CPU and memory in proportion (1 CPU : 4 GB) to handle more jobs and events, though that adds no web workers; scaling horizontally with more control nodes behind a load balancer adds redundancy and spreads web traffic.
questions: How much control capacity does a job use?
Should I scale control nodes vertically or horizontally?
What CPU to memory ratio is recommended for control nodes?
